description: What an airplane is in a few words, from the aircraft registry's maker and model (ACFTREF): its maker without the words that say what kind of company it is ("AIRBUS S A S" Airbus, "PIPER AIRCRAFT INC" Piper) and its model without the variant ("A321-271NX" A321; one starting with letters alone keeps its number, "PA-28-140" PA-28). The owner's "Maybe just Airbus A321" (2026-11-27). A name's shortening, no aviation rule.
